executiveSummary: GM0243 passes the deterministic execution contract for all ten canonical presets, T+0/6/12/24/48/72 and all eight essential services. Its CBS/PDOK 2025 identity, 50,042 residents, 61 neighbourhoods, two BAG places, four BRT settlement labels, one in-boundary ProRail station, 47 scheduled-transit stop areas and six section-traceable NWB border links are coherent. Current road semantics correctly limit NWB corridors to Mobility and road-logistics Supply. Release is nevertheless correction-required. Harderwijk lies at the Wolderwijd/Veluwemeer Randmeren and contains low waterfront, urban drainage and wooded Veluwe contexts, yet the named Rhine/Meuse/IJssel preset produces 1.407869 normalized flood stress, 24,929 affected people-equivalent at T+24 and the browser headline 94 percent inundation stress without selecting a connected source-water, defence, breach/overtopping, lake wind-setup, footprint, depth, arrival or recession case. That precise field stays unchanged through T+72. Conversely, zero direct North Sea inundation in the coastal preset is a narrow source screen and cannot be presented as an all-water all-clear. Eight unrelated nonzero hazard families reuse the exact same 61-neighbourhood ranking; a controlled ignition inside the official Harderwijk7 combustible-nature polygon and CBS Harderwijkerbos still ranks its source neighbourhood thirteenth. Public HWH/DAMO registers expose RWZI Harderwijk, three surface-water pumps and 28 weirs, but no compatible capacities or topology, while the model does not use them. A live exact-boundary REV query returns 20 unique regulated-activity identifiers including LPG, propane, three gas stations and legacy rest-category records, but there is no hazardous-material or industrial-release scenario. St Jansdal is an official 24/7 acute-care location, and A28, N302/Aquaduct Veluwemeer, N303/N796, rail and cross-boundary aid routes matter, but none has event-valid passability, resource or physical utility state. Exact first-72-hour service and recovery values therefore remain scenario exercises rather than local forecasts. All public registers, observations, plans and official scenarios must retain edition, valid time, resolution, licence, coverage, NoData and affectsSimulation metadata; absent records and transparent cells remain Unknown, never zero or safe.

findings.summary: The complete deterministic municipality contract, reconciliation and road-only service-scope safeguards pass.

findings.summary: The precise Rhine/Meuse/IJssel result is not supported by a selected Harderwijk/Randmeren hydraulic pathway.
findings.evidence: At T+24 and T+72 the model holds 1.407869 flood stress and 0.437149 severity, reaching 24,929 then 26,565 affected people-equivalent; desktop and mobile headline 94 percent inundation stress. VNOG distinguishes IJssel and Randmeren regional drivers, while RWS identifies Wolderwijd as a Randmeer and treats Harderwijk navigation openings, lake wind setup, time dependence and bottlenecks. No source water, level, defence/breach/overtopping, connected footprint, depth, probability, arrival or recession case was selected.
findings.action: Treat current amplitude as a hidden non-operational diagnostic and selected-municipality local impact as Unknown. Add a typed Wolderwijd/Veluwemeer-Randmeren event adapter using an expert-selected versioned LIWO/WMCN/Vallei en Veluwe case; do not assume impossible exposure or all-clear from proximity alone.

findings.summary: Zero direct North Sea inundation is narrow but the UI can be read as zero flood risk for a lake-edge municipality.
findings.evidence: The coastal preset has zero direct flood stress and zero affected at T+24 but 20.670237 m/s wind, while the browser hero says 0 percent inundation stress. findings.action: Retain the exact zero only as a labelled direct-North-Sea source screen. Present Randmeren/regional/pluvial pathways as Unknown unless selected, and never collapse direct-coast zero into an all-water safe state.

findings.summary: Pluvial and drainage precision ignores Harderwijk's integrated urban-water system and public asset uncertainty.
findings.evidence: Pluvial T+24 reports 0.644499 flood stress, 12,697 affected and pressure 0.320091 after rain has fallen to zero, then clears direct stress at T+72. Municipal policy says the sewer/infiltration/surface-water/groundwater system was being jointly recalculated in 2024/2025. The cache has 32 HWH objects, all with capacity null, and no connectivity/control/live state.
findings.action: Use a versioned municipal or national cloudburst case plus terrain, imperviousness and validated catchment/control data. Until then suppress neighbourhood/depth/recovery precision, expose NoData, and keep HWH assets context-only.

findings.summary: Wildfire source containment and forest-context allocation fail a controlled official-polygon test.
findings.evidence: Canonical T+24 wildfire shows zero flame, 0.509745 smoke and 3,104 affected. With a controlled source inside IPO Harderwijk7 and CBS Harderwijkerbos, flame is 0.619887 and smoke 0.583299, but source neighbourhood Harderwijkerbos ranks thirteenth at 0.686962 while Slingerbos Noord remains first at 0.728479. Eight hazard families share this same ranking.
findings.action: Make source containment, official fuel eligibility, event-valid KNMI wind/moisture, terrain, spread, access and suppression explicit inputs. The IPO polygon is eligibility only; before those inputs exist, local fire impact remains Unknown.

findings.summary: One hash-derived neighbourhood order creates cross-hazard false precision.
findings.evidence: Storm, pluvial, river, coastal, heat, winter, cyber and wildfire all rank 61 neighbourhoods identically at T+24. Slingerbos Noord, Weisteeg and Stadsdennen Noord lead regardless of source, while Waterfront, forest, hospital and industrial areas do not move according to mechanism. No GM0243 unsupportedDimensions are emitted.
findings.action: Add GM0243 to the unsupported spatial guard for all nine spatial families and make compound inherit unresolved components. Replace the shared hash with independently tested source-aware surfaces before emitting neighbourhood impacts.

findings.summary: Regulated gas/fuel and other external-safety sources have no explicit event scope.
findings.evidence: Full-boundary REV filtering returns 20 unique regulated-activity identifiers: four LPG refuelling, five gas tanks, three gas stations and eight rest-category records, including Lorentz/industrial addresses. The ten canonical presets have no hazardous-material, toxic-plume, explosion or industrial-fire scenario. Registration does not prove current inventory or incident.
findings.action: State industrial/hazardous-material events are unsupported, not zero. A future operator-reviewed exercise may use REV only for registered location/type context plus a selected release/effect model and valid-time weather; never auto-trigger from geometry.

findings.summary: Exact water and drainage service percentages lack catchment, throughput, power and restoration evidence.
findings.evidence: RWZI Harderwijk, three surface-water pumps and 28 weirs are public context, but every normalized capacity is null. River T+24 gives water 0.473804 and drainage 0.274871; compound gives 0.366090 and 0.230132. No object connectivity, control, backup, staff/access or receiving-water state causes those numbers.
findings.action: Retain objects on the map with CC BY-SA provenance and no-capacity warnings. Only enable causal use after unit/catchment/direction/control/quality validation; otherwise use explicitly synthetic typed nodes with scenario-unit ranges.

findings.summary: A28, N302/Aquaduct Veluwemeer, rail and local access lack typed event-valid continuity.
findings.evidence: Removing the N302 Zeewolde logical link in compound T+24 changes pressure +0.003700, mobility -0.025031 and supply -0.005806, proving meaningful model sensitivity. But the edge is only a four-section NWB border proxy. NDW has zero matched situations, and neither NWB, ProRail nor GTFS establishes bridge/aquaduct/rail passability, direction, emergency throughput or repair access.
findings.action: Retain NWB Mobility/Supply-only links and physical section ids. Add typed Aquaduct Veluwemeer, A28 and rail continuity nodes with valid-time NDW/RWS/ProRail matching; no-match stays Unknown and closures require explicit mode/direction/time/capacity semantics.

findings.summary: St Jansdal and public utility/telecom context do not justify live capacity, backup or recovery.
findings.evidence: RIVM reports St Jansdal 24/7 acute care, 18 rooms and 24,660 visits in 2025; RDI has 66 antenna sites and NBNL one Liander planning sample. None supplies live occupancy, acceptance, staff, generator/fuel, feeder/backhaul, switching, damage or restoration. Public topology is incomplete or security-sensitive.
findings.action: Keep registers context-only. Add operator-reviewed scenario resource ranges where authorized; otherwise use minimal synthetic hospital/utility/telecom gateways with transparent dependencies, backup endurance and uncertainty, never implied observed state.

findings.summary: T+24-72 persistence and facility decline are not tied to actions, access or resources.
findings.evidence: River stress and seven service availabilities freeze from T+24 to T+72 while facilities falls 0.494539 to 0.328798 and cumulative burden reaches 1,823,017.93 person-hours. Compound flood stress also freezes, facilities falls 0.455772 to 0.252630 and burden reaches 2,186,276.37. No selected hydraulic case, backup endurance, crew/material/stock inventory, dispatch, access or restoration commitment supports the curves.
findings.action: Gate damage, backup, dispatch, mutual aid and repair by event/resource/access state with uncertainty. If evidence is missing, show an assumption range or Unknown instead of an exact recovery promise or freeze.

findings.summary: Evidence disclosures are strong, but precise selected-municipality hero values outrun their unsupported status.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile at river T+24 show Harderwijk, T+24:00 and '94% inundation stress · derived-screening'; coastal shows '0% inundation stress' and wildfire shows '0% fire intensity' despite smoke. The selected model emits no unsupportedDimensions, while a national unsupported-count warning does not explain Harderwijk's specific gap. Desktop and 390×844 mobile had no horizontal overflow, page errors or failed local responses; all 11 layers remained selectable at compound T+72.
findings.action: Keep provenance rows, timestamps, NoData language and responsive layout. Replace unsupported hero precision with a municipality-specific Unknown card that names missing source water/fire input, scenario selection and affectsSimulation=false; distinguish flame from smoke and direct North Sea zero from lake-flood unknown.

corrections.summary: Guard GM0243 and replace shared hash ranking with mechanism-specific source-aware local allocation.
corrections.validation: Add GM0243 unsupported notes for all nine spatial families and make compound inherit unresolved components. Tests require Unknown/grey local output, no precise affected/service downstream value while unsupported, independent rankings where mechanisms differ, source-aware Harderwijk7 containment, exact no-event behavior, reconciliation and layer invariance.

corrections.summary: Replace river/coast ambiguity with a governed Randmeren/LIWO event adapter.
corrections.validation: Pin LIWO release 2025.1.6 and dataset projects/deltares-rws/liwo/2025_0_1, then require scenario id/model date, Wolderwijd/Veluwemeer source-water family, boundary level, navigation-opening and defence/breach/overflow state, probability, native CRS/cell size, depth units/bands, arrival/duration/recession, licence, retrieval and NoData before affectsSimulation=true. Suppress current 1.407869/24,929 precision pending selection; retain North Sea zero only under that narrow label.

corrections.summary: Integrate pluvial/water-chain public data without fabricating capacity or operation.
corrections.validation: Use an authorized versioned BuRWKA/stress-test export when its licence, native resolution and NoData contract are established, or the labelled national 70 mm/2 h scenario as context. Keep all 32 HWH records affectsSimulation=false while capacityUnit/catchment/control is absent. Tests must prevent null capacity or transparent raster cells becoming zero, dry, open or operational.

corrections.summary: Add safe wildfire and industrial unsupported scope with optional selected-event adapters.
corrections.validation: Wildfire tests place the controlled source inside IPO Harderwijk7/BU02431403 and require source-aware spread using event-valid weather/fuel/access inputs. REV records remain context-only; UI says hazardous-material/toxic/explosion scenarios are unsupported. No register geometry may auto-trigger a live incident or invent inventory.

corrections.summary: Add typed Harderwijk access/care/service gateways while retaining road-only logical proxies.
corrections.validation: Retain daily/monthly NWB wvk/wegnummer identity and Mobility/Supply-only scope. Add non-additive N302/Aquaduct Veluwemeer, A28 and rail nodes with valid-time operational matching. Add St Jansdal and minimal synthetic utility/telecom gateways only with evidence class, scenario-unit ranges, backup/dependency assumptions and uncertainty. No NDW/RDI/NBNL/RIVM no-match becomes an all-clear.

corrections.summary: Replace exact generic recovery with event/resource/access-gated trajectories and strengthen selected-municipality evidence UX.
corrections.validation: T+0/6/12/24/48/72 exposes selected forcing, damage, access, backup, crew/material/stock assumptions, response delay, ramp and uncertainty. Tests prevent unexplained flood/service freezes and current-observation projection. Browser checks require GM0243 Unknown states, separate North Sea/Randmeren semantics, flame/smoke distinction, source/version/valid-time/NoData/affectsSimulation on map/chart/inspector/export, and no desktop/mobile regression.

residualLimitations: VNOG establishes regional risk mechanisms, dependencies and roles, not a current event, Harderwijk probability, live resource inventory or guaranteed action.

No reviewed source selects a Wolderwijd/Veluwemeer, IJssel, regional-water or pluvial boundary condition, defence/navigation-opening/breach state, connected footprint, depth, probability, arrival, duration, recession or dewatering path for this run.
LIWO catalogue/service access and breach-candidate markers do not select a hydraulic event; model date, variant, bands, resolution, coverage, licence and NoData remain independent provenance fields.
The municipal 2024 report is policy/model-development context; an authorized machine-readable stress-test export, reuse licence, native resolution, edition and NoData contract were not established.

HWH/DAMO and REV are retrieval-time registers with variable or source-holder completeness; geometry and registration do not establish connectivity, compatible capacity, inventory, condition or current operation.
IPO combustible-area geometry is static eligibility, not ignition, fuel moisture, fire perimeter, spread, access or suppression state.

NWB, ProRail and GTFS establish road/rail/scheduled geometry and NDW can add valid-time situations; none alone supplies aquaduct/bridge/rail passability, emergency throughput, vehicles or repair access.
RIVM acute-care data is dated questionnaire capacity, not live acceptance, occupancy, staffing, backup, supplies or access.
RDI antenna points do not establish radio coverage, ownership, traffic, backhaul, power, backup or restoration; the one NBNL sample is not municipality-wide electricity topology or present state.
KNMI/RIVM/Waterinfo observations retain their own observation time and spatial support; nearest or absent points are not municipal surfaces, forecasts or T+72 inputs.
Transient visitors/workers and individual medical dependence are not observed; CBS resident/household aggregates must not be silently expanded into concurrent people-present.
Desktop/mobile smoke checked the running local app and public overlays, not full assistive-technology, offline, low-bandwidth, operational-security or field-device readiness.
